issue_context.title: New Tab Drop-down should be keyboard accessible
issue_context.body:
# Description of the new feature/enhancement
Users should be able to display the "new tab drop-down" using a key chord.

I'd prefer <kbd>CTRL</kbd><kbd>SHIFT</kbd><kbd>SPACE</kbd> but I am sure others would prefer a different chord, so this chord-action should key-mappable.
comments: OK we should probably leave this default mapped for accessibility but then let people who don't want it to remove it.

review_comments: What happens when the dropdown is already visible?
The keybinding is ignored and the <kbd>Space</kbd> key will open the first profile in the list
Oh that's an actually good behavior.
Does this move UIA focus into the new tab dropdown? Should it? cc @carlos-zamora

Good news: Xaml handles all of that for us as we change focus with the keyboard
"Bad" news: navigation between the flyout and its parent isn't great (but that's an existing issue). That'll get fixed in #2102 by me
